name: Kingless Dungeon
detailed_description:
Description:

Kingless Dungeon is a fast-paced Hack and Slash action platformer that invites the player to explore an ancient and dark dungeon, taking on the role of its master: a Prince of Shadows who believes himself to be the hero of this world, as his memory has been altered by an unfortunate accident. Instead of delving deeper into the dungeon, the player must find a way out after concluding that the main threat has already been eliminated.

This is a university project developed by a group of student at the Complutense University of Madrid (UCM), as their first game during their freshman year. 

Please note that the game does not include a save system, but the full experience can be completed in approximately 30 minutes.

Story:

In the darkest corner of the Kingdom, in the Dungeon of Shadows, resides the Villain — the infamous Prince of Shadows — whose loyal servants terrorize the world. The Villain rarely leaves his lair, but all know of his fearsome powers, rivaled only by the strength of the Hero.

However, not even the Prince’s abilities could defy the elementary laws of gravity. The Villain slipped and hit the ground while descending the dungeon stairs, lost his memories, and awoke confused at the foot of his throne. Alone in a massive chamber, he believed himself to be the hero who had just defeated the dungeon boss. “Victorious,” he decided to leave the dungeon, bravely fighting his way out — unaware that he was slaying his own minions and loyal servants.

Open source:

The game is open source on GitHub, so you're welcome to submit your own ideas, creativity, or participate in development!

Project lead: .../Proyectos1-FDI-UCM/c2425-Grupo03

Completely Free!

This game is entirely free to play, so there's no reason not to give it a try! Its main purpose is to showcase our university project.

short_description: 《Kingless Dungeon》 is a 2D hack and slash platformer where you control the Shadow Prince, a warrior with no memory. Fight undead enemies, discover your skills, and explore this deep dungeons filled with traps and secrets. Can you reclaim your memories and escape?
